column1: # Formats read from a KVR Studio Manager scan log (macOS, 2026-09-13).
# Read by `pnpm identifiers:apply --rows`.
# target<TAB>format<TAB>identifier<TAB>version<TAB>source
#   identifier `-` adds the format alone: the log carries no bundle ids at
#   all, only name/brand/version/format per scanned plugin, so every row
#   here is a format the entry ships in and did not list.
# The scan's 1687 plugin rows collapse to 1267 products; 137 resolved to a
# catalog entry on an exact or punctuation-insensitive name match under the
# same manufacturer, and only these five lacked a format they were observed
# in. Versions went through `add-telemetry-versions.ts` instead, which is
# the lane that owns them (27 entries, see the commit).
# Rejected, and why:
#   fabfilter-*  vst3 versions  — FabFilter's VST3 bundles report a two-digit
#       minor with an inserted dot ("3.2.3.0" where the AU and AAX bundles of
#       the same install both read "3.23"). Every FabFilter version below was
#       taken from the format majority, so the mangled reading is outvoted
#       rather than written. A scan carrying VST3 alone for this maker has no
#       usable version.
#   soundtheory-gullfoss  au    — the shell lists only VST3 for Gullfoss; the
#       entry's AU is not evidenced by this log either way.
# Not matched, left for a person or a later import:
#   ~1077 Waves names are WaveShell component names (per-band and per-channel
#       variants, shorthand: "RCompressor", "SSLComp", "Q4", "REQ 6"), which
#       do not stand 1:1 against catalog product names. Fuzzy-matching these
#       is what the reviewed-list contract exists to avoid.
#   44 Universal Audio names are members of "Collection" entries, the known
#       limitation already recorded in 2026-09-identifier-backfill-telemetry.tsv
#       (one `identifiers` value per format cannot express a collection).
#   roli ROLI Studio Player / ROLI Studio Drums — no `roli` product entries
#       exist in any collection; a genuine gap, needs a real import.
#   roland SP-404MKII (VST3, Roland Cloud) — no SP-404MKII entry in software
#       or hardware; a genuine gap.
#   soundtheory Gullfoss Live / Gullfoss Master — separate products from
#       Gullfoss, neither in the catalog.
#   native-instruments Kontakt 7 / Kontakt 8 — the catalog models Kontakt as
#       one entry with a version history, not per-major entries. Correct as is.
#   sonible smartReverb / smartComp2 — the scan is v1 and v2, the catalog
#       carries smart:reverb 2 and smart:comp 3. Already recorded in the
#       telemetry review list.
# Also noticed, out of scope for this pass: waves-rs56 duplicates
# waves-abbey-road-rs56-passive-eq, and waves-the-king-s-microphones
# duplicates waves-abbey-road-the-king-s-microphones.
fabfilter-pro-q-3
